description: Get a single ayah (verse) of the Quran by reference — either surah:ayah (e.g. "2:255" for Ayat al-Kursi) or a global ayah number (1-6236). Returns the verse text in the chosen edition (translation like en.asad / en.sahih, or Arabic via quran-uthmani).

edition.description: Edition identifier. Default 'en.asad'. Use 'quran-uthmani' for Arabic.

reference.description: Verse reference: "surah:ayah" like "2:255", or a global ayah number like "262".

name: get_ayah
title: Get Ayah
